title: Domain-Driven Clean Architecture and Strict OOP/SOLID Refactoring

ears_requirements.system_response: organize the codebase into concentric Domain-Driven Clean Architecture layers consisting of domain, application, infrastructure, and presentation
ears_requirements.full_statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL organize the codebase into concentric Domain-Driven Clean Architecture layers consisting of domain, application, infrastructure, and presentation.

ears_requirements.system_response: strictly uphold the four pillars of Object-Oriented Programming (Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, Polymorphism) across all domain models, contracts, and services
ears_requirements.full_statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL strictly uphold the four pillars of Object-Oriented Programming (Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance, Polymorphism) across all domain models, contracts, and services.

ears_requirements.system_response: enforce SOLID design principles with inversion of control where application use cases depend exclusively on abstract domain ports
ears_requirements.full_statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL enforce SOLID design principles with inversion of control where application use cases depend exclusively on abstract domain ports.

ears_requirements.system_response: preserve complete functional compatibility with existing public APIs, CLI entrypoints, and PyTorch causal decoder-only execution models
ears_requirements.full_statement: THE SYSTEM SHALL preserve complete functional compatibility with existing public APIs, CLI entrypoints, and PyTorch causal decoder-only execution models.

ears_requirements.trigger: the test harness runs the test suite
ears_requirements.system_response: pass all existing and newly authored architecture/SOLID unit tests with zero regressions
ears_requirements.full_statement: WHEN the test harness runs the test suite THE SYSTEM SHALL pass all existing and newly authored architecture/SOLID unit tests with zero regressions.

bdd_scenarios.name: Domain layer isolation and dependency inversion
given: The domain layer contains entities, value objects, and abstract interface contracts
bdd_scenarios.when: A use case in the application layer executes
then: It interacts solely through abstract domain interfaces (ITokenizer, ICausalLM, IKVCache, ISafetyGuard, ITrainer)
Concrete infrastructure dependencies are injected via constructor arguments

bdd_scenarios.name: Strict OOP 4 Pillars and SOLID compliance
given: The model, cache, tokenizer, trainers, safety guards, and evaluators are defined as classes
bdd_scenarios.when: The OOP unit verification suite runs
then: Encapsulation is verified through protected state and properties
Abstraction is verified through formal ABC contracts
Inheritance is verified through clear subclass hierarchies
Polymorphism is verified through uniform interface execution across implementations

bdd_scenarios.name: Preservation of test and CLI verification suite
bdd_scenarios.when: pytest and CLI entrypoints are invoked
then: All original 30 tests pass without modification or breakage
CLI subcommands edit, benchmark, and profile operate identically

non_functional_constraints: Pure PyTorch primitives (torch.nn.Module) without HuggingFace Transformers high-level abstractions
Zero device breakage: device-agnostic CPU and CUDA execution
Clean directory separation conforming to Domain-Driven Design (domain, application, infrastructure, presentation)
